products.name: Veed.io AI
products.note: Online video editing AI; auto-subtitle; text-to-speech; UK-hosted

profile_text.body:
VEED is a UK-hosted online video creation platform aimed primarily at marketers and solopreneurs. The company describes its core proposition as an end-to-end workflow that combines video generation and editing in a single product, allowing users to create talking-head videos, dub content into other languages, and add subtitles without switching between separate tools.

The platform's AI capabilities include a text-to-video generator, an image-to-video tool, AI avatars, a dubbing tool, an AI text-to-speech voice generator, an automatic subtitle generator, background noise removal, eye-contact correction, and a clip generator. VEED also offers a suite of developer-facing APIs covering lip sync, subtitles, background removal, green screen, and live avatars, and lists its own model, Fabric 1.0, alongside third-party models such as Sora 2, Veo 3.1, and Kling AI as available options within the platform. The site also references a product called VideoGPT.

The held facts record VEED's primary tracked product as Veed.io AI, categorized under Video Generation and Editing, and note that the service is UK-hosted. No litigation, SEC filings, MCP server registrations, or patent records are present in the available data.
